summary: Three cases. p = N: the submodule from the Fourier operator (`exists_indexDvd_fourierOp_pow`) and `gaugeLe_Bmu_at_N`. p non-split below x₁ and served: S = Y^m M + p^{j_p}M with `hasType_prod_markOperator_pow`, and the two gauge bounds. Otherwise S = M (IndexDvd with l = 0) with `gaugeLe_collisionSum` (non-split, not served) or `gaugeLe_one`.

steps.claim: k: for any ϑ, Ψ, φ, if B_μ(ϑ, Ψ)(φ) has GaugeLe(1, p^c) with c ≤ −β, then p^{−β}·B_μ(ϑ, Ψ)(φ) ∈ integralFormsAt(⊤, 1) (gauge ≤ p^{c+β} ≤ 1).
steps.lean:
have k {ϑ Ψ φ} {c : ℝ} (h : GaugeLe 1 (p ^ c) (D.Bμ ϑ Ψ φ)) (e : c ≤ -β := by linarith) :
      (p : ℂ) ^ (-β) • Bμ ϑ Ψ φ ∈ integralFormsAt ⊤ 1 := ⟨⟨⟩, fun g ↦ by
    erw [weylGauge_smul]; grw [h g, e] <;> simp [norm_p_eq_inv, rpow_neg, NeZero.one_le, NeZero.ne]⟩
steps.typed_fact: (p : ℂ) ^ (-β) • Bμ ϑ Ψ φ ∈ integralFormsAt ⊤ 1

steps.claim: Unfold allowedLoss; cases p ∈ nonsplitPrimes, p = N, other; the case p = N first.
steps.lean: unfold allowedLoss at *; split_ifs at * with h hN <;> simp [Nat.lt_ceil, hp.1] at h; swap

· subst hN; have : 1 ≤ D.m * D.f * D.b :=
      D.le_of_hasLogBound; peel D.exists_indexDvd_fourierOp_pow
    exact ⟨_, this.comap _ le_rfl fun _ _ ↦ mem_comap.2, fun _ _ G _ _ c r ↦
      k (D.gaugeLe_Bmu_at_N _ G r c)⟩

steps.claim: From `exists_indexDvd_fourierOp_pow`: e ≤ 4mfb·dim Column and IndexDvd(integral columns, S, N^e) for S the columns φ with F^{ϱ+1}φ ∈ integralFormsAt(Column, diagPointN 0) (the pull-back by F^{ϱ+1} of the forms integral at diagPointN 0, restricted to Column).
For φ ramified in it: GaugeLe(1, N^{3mfb}) by `gaugeLe_Bmu_at_N`, and 3mfb ≤ −β (β < −4mfb + 1); conclude with k.
steps.lean:
exact ⟨_, this.comap _ le_rfl fun _ _ ↦ mem_comap.2, fun _ _ G _ _ c r ↦
      k (D.gaugeLe_Bmu_at_N _ G r c)⟩

have := D.hasLogUpper_of_le_of_nonneg h.1.le; have :=
    D.le_of_hasLogBound (F := 1).trans (D.le_loss p)

steps.claim: Either p is served — then a full mark Λ exists (`exists_isMarked`) — or m·collisionSum(p, ∅) ≤ loss(p) (`mul_collisionSum_le_loss`).

steps.lean:
· peel hΛ.hasType_prod_markOperator_pow.2; refine ⟨_, this, fun _ _ G Q _ e _ ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨u, U, rfl⟩, _, ⟨v, V, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := mem_sup.1 e
    simpa using!
      add_mem (k (G.gaugeLe_Bmu_of_isMarked Q U hΛ)) (k (G.gaugeLe_pow_jetCeil_smul Q V h))

steps.claim: By `hasType_prod_markOperator_pow`: IndexDvd(M, S, p^l) (determinant condition) with l ≤ 3loss·dim = err·dim.
steps.lean: · peel hΛ.hasType_prod_markOperator_pow.2; refine ⟨_, this, fun _ _ G Q _ e _ ↦ ?_⟩

steps.claim: Write φ ∈ S as Y^m u + p^{j_p}v with u, v integral.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨_, ⟨u, U, rfl⟩, _, ⟨v, V, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := mem_sup.1 e

steps.claim: Both parts are integral after p^{−β}: GaugeLe(1, p^{2loss − gain}) (`gaugeLe_Bmu_of_isMarked`) and GaugeLe(1, p^{loss − gain}) (`gaugeLe_pow_jetCeil_smul`), both exponents ≤ −β since β < gain − 3loss + 1; sum.
steps.lean:
simpa using!
      add_mem (k (G.gaugeLe_Bmu_of_isMarked Q U hΛ)) (k (G.gaugeLe_pow_jetCeil_smul Q V h))

steps.claim: Remaining cases: take l = 0 and S = the integral columns.
steps.lean: all_goals use 0, mod_cast by bound, D.integralColumns, by simp, fun _ _ G Q φ c _ ↦ ?_

steps.claim: Non-split, not served: GaugeLe(1, p^{m·coll + loss − gain}) (`gaugeLe_collisionSum`) with m·coll ≤ loss and β < gain − 3loss + 1.
Other primes (p ≠ N, p not non-split below x₁, so p ≠ d as d < x₁ is ramified): GaugeLe(1, 1) by `gaugeLe_one`, and β ≤ 0.
steps.lean:
exact k (rpow_zero _ ▸ G.gaugeLe_one Q c hN
    (by rintro rfl; simpa [chiK] using h D.lt_of_hasLogBound)) (by norm_cast at *; lia)
